entry.name: jit.iter
entry.digest: Iterate a matrix as lists or values
entry.description: Iterates through all the cells of a matrix, sending a message or list for each cell out the object's left outlet. Output is one item per plane of data. A list of ints is sent out the middle outlet that containing the current cell coordinates.
